verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, yuninal winhaj Hanani, yik b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Baasa icha tik:

Te malaj elk'ochi, palta ach wik'cha'anh, ix ach wak'anoch yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik, palta haxo sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam tza b'eyb'alej. Ix a kuchb'anb'at in chonhab' tik t'a chukal, yuj chi' ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol yuj he chukal chi'.
Yuj chi' ach Baasa, ol ach in satel yet' masanil inhtilal, icha ix wutej in satanel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.
Yalnhej mach heb' a k'ab' ok ol cham t'a yoltak chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at heb', haxo heb' ol cham t'a kaltak te', a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Baasa chi' yet' jantak owal ix yak' ganar winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Tirsa, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Ela ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú schekab', haton winh yuninal winhaj Hanani, tastak ya'elal ol jawok t'a yib'anh winhaj Baasa yet' heb' yinhtilal yet' sk'ab' yok, yujto te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' winh, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam. Ix kotpax ya'elal t'a yib'anh winh yujto ix satel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' winh.
Ayik 26 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ela yuninal winhaj Baasa yak'an reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Tirsa. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Ay jun winh Zimri sb'i, yajal winh t'a nanhal heb' soldado tzek' yet' carruaje yik owal, a winh ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Ela chi'. Ay jun k'ual ayek' winhaj Ela chi' t'a Tirsa, t'a spat winhaj Arsa, winh tz'ilan spalacio winh rey. Haxo ix aji, ix yuk' anh winh rey chi', ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winh.
Elanhchamel ix k'och winhaj Zimri chi', ix smilancham winh rey chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix uji jun tik ayik 27 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Anhej wal yik ix och winhaj Zimri chi' reyal, ix smilancham masanil yinhtilal winhaj Baasa chi' winh. Manhxa junok winak ix kani, manhxa pax junok sk'ab' yok winh, ma junok yamigo winh ix kani.
Icha wal chi' ix aj satel masanil yinhtilal winhaj Baasa chi', icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú yuj winhaj Baasa chi'.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Baasa chi' yet' winhaj Ela yuninal winh, ix och smul heb' winh yuj skuchb'anb'at heb' israel yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová heb'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ela chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Ayik 27 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Zimri yak'an reyal t'a Tirsa, palta ukenhej k'ual ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' ayek' heb' soldado yik Israel yak' owal t'a Gibetón t'a yol yik heb' filisteo.
Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to ix miljicham winh rey yuj winhaj Zimri, yuj chi' wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'anoch winhaj Omri heb' sreyalok, haton winh yajalil heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yaktej winhaj Omri chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado t'a Gibetón chi', haxo t'a chonhab' Tirsa ix k'och heb' yak' owal.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Zimri chi' to wan yak'ji ganar jun chonhab' chi', ix och winh t'a yol scuartel t'a yol spalacio, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh.
Icha chi' ix aji yujto te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to a wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zimri chi' yet' tas ix snacha'anh winh t'a spatik winhaj Ela, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ix spoj sb'a chonhab' Israel, cha poj ix aj heb': Jun makan heb', a winhaj Tibni yuninal winhaj Ginat snib'ej heb' tz'och reyal. Haxo junxo makan heb', ix kan heb' yet' winhaj Omri.

Haxo ix aji, a heb' ix kan yet' winhaj Omri chi', más jelan heb' t'a yichanh heb' ix och yet' winhaj Tibni chi', yuj chi' ix miljicham winhaj Tibni chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Omri chi' ix ochkan reyal.
Ayik 31 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Omri chi' yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh, wake' ab'il ix ek' winh t'a Tirsa.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smanan jun lum tzalan winh t'a Samaria t'a winhaj Semer. Nanhal schab'il quintal k'e'en plata ix yak' winh stojolok lu'um. Haxo ta' ix sb'ok'e jun chonhab' winh, Samaria ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto Semer sb'i winh b'aj ix sman lum lum chi' winh.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Omri chi', te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová, ek'b'al schukal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ek'nak.

Ix sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' stzuntzejnakkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová Dios heb'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Omri yet' tas ix sk'ulej yet' tastak ix yak' ganar winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Acab ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayxo 38 ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ayik ix och winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Omri reyal t'a Israel. 22 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ek'b'al chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ek'nak.

Malaj yalan sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat t'a winh. Ek'b'al te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', ix yik' ix Jezabel yisil winhaj Et-baal sreyal Sidón winh yetb'eyumok, ix ochpax winh ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Baal.
Ix sb'ok'e stemploal Baal chi' winh yet' jun altar t'a Samaria.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun yechel komon Dios skuch Asera winh. Ix ste tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh, yujto ek'b'al chuk ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel ek'nak.

Ayik ayoch winhaj Acab chi' reyal, haxo winhaj Hiel aj Betel ix b'oanxik'e chonhab' Jericó. Ayik ix yak'anxiem yich jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix cham jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh skuch Abiram. Haxo yik ix och spuertail, ix cham winhaj Segub slajwub' yuninal winh. Ix elk'och icha tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun.
